title: Not Every List Is a Set! Sets Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Ask three friends to list the good students in your class and you get three different lists. Ask them for the students who ride a bicycle to college and the lists match exactly. Why does one list work and the other fail? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 1, Sets) we learn what a set really is and the two ways to write one.

You will watch a live membership test sort numbers into a set one by one, see why a set must be well-defined, and meet the symbols for belongs to and does not belong to. We place the natural numbers, integers, rational numbers and real numbers (N, Z, Q, R) on one number line, then write the same set in roster form and in set builder form, and change one limit live to see why the rule beats the list for big sets. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example with the primes below 20, the exam trap about integers and squares, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.
